verdict.rationale: Opting out of a monitoring platform's own telemetry or usage tracking (for example in its SDK, CLI, or self-hosted install) is a fair question for Sentry, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the pack documents a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out. The self-hosted docs only show that Sentry can run on your own server, not that its product telemetry can be disabled.
